title: fucking really?
author: june
body:
i genuinely dont know why this is pissing me off as much as it is
i left her on seen ages ago, not yesterday, 5 mins ago, weeks ago. now recently she unadded me

what the fuck am i supposed to make of that
I KNEW YOU FOR 2 YEARS, TALKING TO YOU, KNOWING YOU, HAVING ALL THAT HISTORY AND NOW IM JS A NAME THAT WILL BE MENTIONED ONCE IN UR LIFETIME BC I DIDNT TAKE YOUR FUCKING CAT IN THE HAT CONVO SERIOUSLY

"js say you dont care" YOU'RE TALKING ABT CAT IN THE FUCKING HAT
AND YET THATS ENOUGH FORR YOU TO "yep, two years gone, click" BOOM UNADDED ME

I never said i wanted her bcak aswell, thats not the points of this vlog. but im pissed off that 2 years is washed, hands wiped completely gone bc i didnt take a convo seriously WHILST I WAS HIGH
maybe she wanted attention, or felt ignored or sick of me. idfk and i never prolly will

what pmo the most is i couldnt and cant do anything abt me
i could msg her, or ask why or add her again
but fuck it, if she wants me gone, let her have it

im fking pissed bc 2 years of MY LIFE shouldnt feel like it can be erased by a single fking click
thats what i hate, not losing her. if she wanted me fucking gone ok
but i hate realizing someone who can mean sm to me decide im js not worth being kept around, feeling like im a burden and then dips without giving an explaination, letting me know or like yk COMMUNICATING.
